The current campaign publisher correctly refuses four new selected owned-name suppression events, but has no closed route to consume their independent review and preserve historical sidecar provenance. This is a bounded #1174 capability extension under #669, separate from #1150's older companion-history compatibility defect.

The exact conditional W07 review covers Bacto_Peptone/peptone, Glebomycin/bluensomycin, Netropsin/congocidin and Starch/corn starch, with complete credited-owner sets and eight whole owners. It does not authorize application, whole-owner acceptance or mapping/role/export admission. Congocidin's unresolved placeholder and other scientific holds remain. All four event keys are new to the historical sidecar; only Corn Starch is presently in an old canonical `other` field, so do not describe this as four old-token removals.

Provide a narrow versioned campaign publication transition that consumes an exact independently reviewed decision binding to actual source completion, current complete owner inventory, native generation and each full event/credit tuple. Preserve the 34 historical sidecar rows physically and append only the four actual reviewed native events. Preserve the baseline, historical 2,955-owner attribution, all prior policy histories and native receipts 1–27; bind the new transition in one approval-free native campaign successor. Do not reuse historical 11/23-pair pins, replace the sidecar with the 21-event diagnostic, change owner-selection rules or bypass Rule K.

Extend existing output reservation, guards, expected-byte recovery backups, late checks and independent replay to the third sidecar target. Test genuine source→native generation→publication, exact positive history retention, full credit sets and all review/source/alias/late-drift/partial-completion negatives. Existing `_validate_pair` is reusable structural validation but cannot establish expected event completeness or credit correctness alone; those require the closed review/inventory contract. Diagnostic source paths and manifest hashes must be explicitly bridged to actual application evidence, not rewritten in prior reviews.

Technical proposal and actual structural controls: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/four-suppression-publication-design-v1`. No suppression implementation or corpus application has occurred in this packet. Root must select the final exact independent binding and review the implemented guard before use.

Design manifest SHA256 `439aabb5c3edcd9ae683a54f18db9a10ba5a7981b42d77f000f5104e2bedfb32`; root rehashed all18members. The genuine W07 conditional science review is sealed with manifest `96283373897369bdd1f010087442fefea84f574000a46e8314d678010c913076`, decision `26c5f381bcf3600f18c54722213c076389d0d17d732bbf760783e1cfdc4d333c`, and native review YAML `99bef708606134cf404608f52e4fa61696fb67412122a27ade5c789d345c1f71`; root rehashed all2,391members and50handoff references. It has15genuine owner captures plus the explicit Corn_Starch null preimage, not16existing owner files.

Independent design review is checking the actual review/peer scopes and proposed transaction. The current fixed registry-row publisher is PR1205 head `e0a75a0c48ba539426b1f70623ea376c7b379ecf`; this issue's suppression extension is still unimplemented. File this scope before code changes; validate and independently review the eventual exact producer head before any campaign application. Existing version1 plans must continue refusing new suppression events.

#1259 private implementation finding: a completed but nonpassing transition review is consumed as supporting the append.

The exact unfrozen consumer snapshot is `ea142b624f90d0ac9282fc2bdeca1d6b5001fb2cc8ca711a8207cb70871e34fb`. The preserved focused fixture is `02e88ed6141d4bb9bec538ffa139f6619952f9544d4b2305b0d1a96cec53caa4`. Neither changed during the reproduction.

The independent probe runs the actual native review schema/rendering, all119 original W07 input byte checks, and the current four-event/owner/credit/source-field joins. Its transition review and source/generation proof declarations are explicitly synthetic unit-fixture inputs. It does not call source `prepare`, source apply, publisher `prepare`, or publication.

The positive `pass_with_limitations` review returns the expected38-row sidecar. Two negative native-valid reviews also return38 rows: verdict `blocked` and verdict `needs_curation`, each with a required check explicitly `failed`. All four target assessments still include a supported transport assessment, isolating the missing overall verdict/check gate. Result SHA: `4537397067f4b91b600ed7a5a75f934c549ec20203dfd261a92f27679a4f3ef2`.

The native validator correctly permits a structured review to record failure when its verdict is nonpassing. The consumer checks completion/independence, target positives and absence of open/deferred target findings, but does not itself require a passing review or reject the failed required check. Schema validity is therefore being mistaken for admissible review disposition at this consumer boundary.

Bounded correction: require an admissible passing native review verdict and reject failed required transition checks, while retaining explicit pass-with-limitations and all original conditional WITHHOLD scopes. Keep target/evidence/input/independence checks, all original pins, the native schema, and root's separate acceptance unchanged. Preserve both negatives, the ordinary positive, and a qualified positive regression. This is not a report of maintained-data mutation or a full source/publication bypass.

Tracked here as the concrete review-consumption defect in this still-private capability implementation; this does not describe a defect in the currently pushed version1 publisher. Independent finding packet has23portable evidence members; root rehashed all of them before this comment. Portable manifest SHA256 `b3fabb3721b42aab734cf03d6e1ce4daea3c5301b5a868c93803e5748a64fadf`. The author is holding the affected repair until this finding is recorded.

The ancillary Xanthine method correction in #1258 will use a separate one-operation source/publication transaction before the final 934-operation campaign is frozen, if its actual evidence publication, independent review and source acceptance pass. The original 1,879 CM/KG cases and all 934 payloads/origins remain unchanged. The source operator permits one head per real worker slot, so a fictional eleventh slot or unpublished origin is not an alternative.

This requires a narrow clarification of the suppression transition's historical input contract: preserve all 27 original receipt hashes in their exact order, and permit only a genuine completed native suffix already present in the subsequent accepted source checkpoint. Reconstruct every additional link and endpoint with the unchanged native full-chain validator and exact protected captures. Keep the 34 historical sidecar rows and Rule K baseline unchanged, and retain the exact eight-owner, six-operation and original-science joins. A suffix cannot excuse changed scientific owner bytes, missing receipts, unreceipted drift, stale endpoints or undeclared files.

No ancillary receipt, future commit or application is claimed to exist yet. The currently successful 27-to-28 mechanical fixture remains intact. Before use, require a real sequential source application, native publication, commit, new source checkpoint/generation and suppression publication control, plus original-prefix, tampered/disconnected/undeclared-suffix and recovery negatives. Independent review must cover this refinement and the final exact producer. No threshold, owner-selection rule, original pin, review gate or native validator is loosened. The older immutable design/review remains historical; this comment records the additional concrete sequencing requirement before implementation.

Two independent preparation-runner defects were reproduced before any full validation run.

* `validate_frozen_head.py` SHA-256 `0cd77013743a522eafa0cea5e9cde84b86cc3f49aff8c48ccd2cfc5fd92ad1be` extracts parsing into `integration_marks`, but its final `coverage_lines` expression (line244) still reads `lines`, which is no longer assigned in `main`. Evaluating that actual AST expression raises `NameError: name 'lines' is not defined`. A successful suite would therefore fail while sealing the summary.
* The declared environment does not set `CAMPAIGN_SUPPRESSION_REVIEW_ROOT` or `CAMPAIGN_SUPPRESSION_INTAKE_ROOT`. Calling the exact frozen `faf71c2b…` integration fixture in that declared environment, without undeclared ambient overrides, raises its actual pytest skip before creating a fixture. Setting only variable names would also leave external original input bytes unbound.

Bounded correction: restore a defined coverage-log input, explicitly set both immutable roots, and bind/recheck the complete fixture source inventory plus logical published Git blobs before/after validation. Preserve all existing source/Claw/history guards and require all20 original plus10 new native integration cases to actually pass; skip remains failure. Add narrow regressions for summary construction and explicit environment/input capture.

`FIXTURE-INPUT-INVENTORY.json` enumerates169 unique external regular files: original W07 pair plus119 inputs, two intake control files, eleven selected materialization bindings, and35 historical files (including the prior-transaction Angust preimage; some paths overlap). It separately enumerates24 tracked fixture/producer inputs, ten actual published head:path blob reads and four worker object repositories. Existing complete Claw producer/revision and runtime guards remain required. Git storage may repack; validate logical blobs, not pack filenames. Generated fixture state is output, not an original source input.

No QC/full suite or production source/publication operation was executed. The missing-root skip is a declared-environment failure; inherited undocumented ambient values could mask it. This is a private validation-runner finding on #1259, not a maintained publisher bypass or scientific defect.

Independent sealed handoff: `preflight/final-suppression-validation-runner-independent-v1/HANDOFF.json`, SHA256 `f619e1be3e1a27b4a016b3a9d65eaa23e5639a800e1fbaae5ff7cd19c47fca6f`; manifest `95d9112fee229c51371de715edbe13532b25c69947f712c8c666a9d9ca16cd3e`. Root records these before correcting the runner. The failed v1 stays immutable.

Confirmed compatibility finding in the old isolated-package regression fixture, before any repair: publisher `1108dd82061a03a4348de447834577a389f2692f15627877042b35f615fd1e24` adds two legitimate native review dependencies, but the unchanged #1195 fixture in test file `d49d9204b8b621f8568ab86e984e3f829c0652bfc97b240b3868c9d7397768fa` copies only the former dependency graph. Its child import fails with missing `scripts/record_review.py` before stale-code assertions or publication execute; `schema/record_review.yaml` is likewise absent. This is not evidence of a stale-code bypass.

Full trace SHA256 `d5c1c29b2af12ae4f7d6ee73d59ebffab57900d257b05d6287e517ff605e1c0f`; exact diagnostic RESULT `a3c47687b2da4406eba034c06de7e894729e0885d9123017cd55d771e4e2e889`, under `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/integration/campaign-suppressions1259-v1/fixture-dependency-finding-v1`. All ten unchanged cases pass with predecessor publisher `9df83185a1c4ac4e0aa9b6497138a9923841bb3b9fe656671ac905987bc2d5f1`; preserved stdout `006dc53bc4fe6c41ffd5a0eacc60c97e6619e8d3a2053d8d83f6c0b232aa0179`.

Bounded correction: add the two actual dependency files to the private fixture copy, retaining all ten parameters and every existing assertion. Do not weaken the publisher or native tests. Independently compare that exact test diff and rerun the affected cases; explicitly rebind the new test hash in final validation inventories. Preserve the prior test and all failed logs.

The combined run is still in progress and has emitted an additional failure beyond these ten; that failure needs its own diagnosis. This comment is not a successful combined/full-suite result, and the runtime must stay frozen until that run finishes. No final commit, full-validation launch or source application is approved by the focused diagnostic.

#1259 new negative fixture asserts rejection after the native boundary that already rejects it

The frozen new test `test_completed_native_review_requires_full_actual_transition_scope[partial-reviewed-targets]` (file SHA `d325f7f05744521a44c9cc309a387e153e9a73b0a57aa6105440f149932be816`) constructs a completed review with four explicitly selected targets but only three reviewed target IDs. It changes coverage to partial, then calls native `validate_review` outside its expected-refusal assertion.

The unchanged native review validator correctly raises `ReviewError: completed review has explicitly selected targets left unreviewed` at `scripts/record_review.py:240`. The intended negative is therefore rejected before the fixture enters its expected publisher refusal. A bounded actual run of the three scope cases produced 2 passed / 1 failed, with exact source1108 and test bytes unchanged; log SHA `ad38f445b8d0d235dd058d86fda093badb203a8382185534906ad8841984e854`.

This is a newly authored negative-test setup defect, not a product acceptance or scientific review bypass. The native gate is behaving correctly. The original combined run remains intact and its complete outcome is reported separately.

Bounded proposed repair after this record: preserve this exact malformed completed-review negative and explicitly assert the native ReviewError at the actual validation boundary. Keep the other two schema-valid review cases (required check not applicable; partial coverage) passing native validation and exercising publisher refusal. Do not weaken the native validator, publisher guard, existing assertions or parameter set. Preserve pre-repair bytes/logs. Re-run all three scope cases together with the affected ten predecessor fixture cases; final committed-head full validation remains mandatory.

The separate reviewer confirmed the actual native boundary and exact minimal test correction in `preflight/campaign-suppressions1259-independent-v1/frozen-review-v1/SCOPE-FIXTURE-ASSESSMENT-v1.json`. No code or fixture has yet been edited.

The final external operator reviewer independently reproduced W07-OPERATOR-LOG-AUDIT-001, a minor defect in its own private evidence-assembly script, not in the maintained source/publication operators.

`assemble_preparatory_audit.py` SHA256 ab87b8b3b4c50c265480814bdaa9a7d9a0bebd69027876ad269f337d9b5e7533 incorrectly requires the literal FileNotFoundError class in abbreviated pytest failure text. The preserved original combined log truncates the child stderr, so the script raises AssertionError before writing its report. A separately captured complete original traceback contains the actual missing record_review.py dependency.

No correction has been made. The bounded correction should use the actual failed node IDs and independently captured complete traceback, preserve the failed script/probe, and continue to distinguish the original 619-pass/11-failure run from the separate corrected 13-case pass. It must not alter operator code, tests or a validation verdict. The worker must independently re-review the corrected private accounting.

Evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/workers/w07/worktree/.temp/final-operator-head-review-v1/findings/W07-OPERATOR-LOG-AUDIT-001/finding.json` and `review/skeptical/own-helper-finding-review.json`. Original combined log SHA256 e961edb08f525ca80cf51d2252358fe12803a3139d8e1f1b438318197e49a4f3; complete traceback d5c1c29b2af12ae4f7d6ee73d59ebffab57900d257b05d6287e517ff605e1c0f. This finding is recorded before the private correction.
